pages.text: The $(item)Barrel$() stores a single item type in bulk. It locks to the first item inserted and displays that item and its count on the front face. Connect it to the $(l:network/network_interface)item network$() by placing it adjacent to a tube.

pages.title: Front Face Interactions
pages.text: The front face has two zones:$(br2)$(bold)Item area$() (inner 12×12): $(bold)Left-click$() to deposit the held stack. $(bold)Right-click$() to retrieve one stack. The barrel stays locked to its item type even when emptied.$(br2)$(bold)Click ring$() (edges) and all other sides: $(bold)Right-click$() to open the barrel UI, where void excess and priority can be configured.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: $(bold)Storage Upgrade$() — raises the tier and capacity by one step:$(br2)Wood → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Emerald → Netherite$(br2)Apply by right-clicking the click ring with the upgrade, or combine in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(bold)Whiteout Tape$() — unlocks a barrel that is locked but empty. Right-click the click ring, or combine in a crafting grid.

pages.title: Ender Barrel
pages.text: Craft a $(item)Barrel$() with an $(item)Ender Upgrade$() to produce two $(item)Ender Barrels$() that share a single inventory across any distance. Both barrels always show the same contents and tier.
